request_timeout.description: Request timeout in seconds for API calls

max_concurrent_requests.description: Maximum number of concurrent requests to send

user_agent.description: User agent string sent with requests

follow_redirects.description: Whether to follow HTTP redirects automatically

max_redirects.description: Maximum number of redirects to follow before stopping

verify_ssl.description: Whether to verify SSL certificates of target servers

sustained_requests_per_second.description: Number of requests per second to send during sustained rate testing

sustained_test_duration_seconds.description: Duration in seconds to sustain the test rate for

burst_test_size.description: Number of rapid-fire requests to send in burst testing to check rate limiting thresholds

auth_endpoint_test_requests.description: Number of requests to send specifically to authentication endpoints to test if they have rate limiting

max_test_requests.description: Maximum total number of requests to send per endpoint during all tests combined

test_requests_per_endpoint.description: Number of test requests to send per individual endpoint for rate limiting detection
